findings.description: get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) unconditionally. The return annotation is tuple[str, str], but self.help is None when no help text was set, so the second element can be None.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command where one argument has help and another does not (so the section is shown). The old code substituted "" for the undocumented argument. Now format_help passes (metavar, None) to formatter.write_dl, which wraps or measures the description and raises a TypeError or AttributeError when it handles None. Impact: --help crashes for such commands.
